sermon.title: Gears of Judgment
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: In “Gears of Judgment,” Pastor David G. Kincer defines judgment as deciding right and wrong from forensic facts, not circumstantial evidence, citing John 7:24 and Deuteronomy 17:6. He contrasts three groups from a prior session, then argues that the Humanist Manifesto’s rights to abortion, divorce and sexual lifestyles fail its own “short of harming others” rule. He cites AVERT and CDC-linked figures on AIDS and abuse and calls for laws that protect children rather than compel lifestyles he calls harmful.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added by hand, and obvious caption errors were corrected; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Sensitive: homosexuality, AIDS/STD statistics, abortion, divorce, public-school sex education, guns, and “put them back in the closet” are kept as spoken. Caption fixes: lensic/fenic/florenc/fluence→forensic; Les→lest; deer→dear; samex→same-sex; transvesti→transvestite; 2 and5→2.5; ire→[unclear] (source list). He says “Jesus in the Bible” in captions (rendered “and the Bible” as elsewhere in the series). Statistics (1.4M/34M HIV, 21k/1.7M AIDS deaths, 636k/40M totals, seatbelt 12k, helmet 1.8k, gun 8k, homosexual lifestyle 26k, 93%/63%/75% disease shares, 93k male rape, 5M kids abused / 460 sexually / one-third same-sex, $5B medical, 1.6% not 10% population, July 2014 CDC) are his figures and are not verified here. Matthew 13:30 and Malachi 3:18 are from the prior session he cites.
